statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail sits at the low-band floor because every hour in this window falls inside the CME weekend halt and no Nasdaq-100 price path can form.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON with no danger window. Tail remains far below the block threshold for every hour published here. The risk described in this assessment is the size of the repricing gap carried into the Sunday reopen at 22:00Z, which falls roughly nineteen hours beyond the final slot, rather than any path inside this window.
headline: A 5% ten-year, $100 oil and a 14.81 VIX sit out the weekend halt after a record-scale expiry, with Tail pinned at its structural floor
body: Every hour in this window falls inside the CME weekend halt. Nasdaq-100 cash settled Friday at 29,644.17, up 197.17 points or 0.67% against a 29,447.00 previous close, finishing near the top of a 29,371.89-29,647.80 range. The E-mini NQ printed last at 29,917.25, up 0.59%, after opening at 29,723.75 and ranging 29,648.00-29,993.25. VIX fell 4.08% to 14.81 and settled at the low of a 14.80-15.63 range. The tape was dispersed rather than directional: the S&P 500 rose 0.17% to 7,650.50 and the Nasdaq Composite 0.39% to 26,522.55 while the Dow slipped 0.18% to 51,682.64. The macro backdrop behind those marks is tight. The FOMC raised the federal funds target range by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00% on 16 September, its first increase since 2023, on a unanimous 12-0 vote, with 16 of 18 participants projecting at least one further increase. The 10-year Treasury settled at 4.998%, up 5.1 basis points, after a 5.008% intraday print, and the 2-year stood near 4.75%. WTI near $100.30 fell 1.58% and Brent near $103.87 fell 0.91%, a third consecutive decline, against an unresolved Saudi East-West pipeline and Yanbu disruption. Friday also cleared roughly $7 trillion of options notional in the second-largest triple witching on record, which Citadel Securities described as a potential reset of the market's technical backdrop once dampening positioning rolls off. That is a conditional sensitivity for the new week, not an observed condition. Live price-path evidence is unavailable for this entire window, and that limitation is the reason Tail is held at the low-band floor rather than any benign reading of the tape: with no venue open, no path can deny mean reversion, and none of the amplifiers that would justify a higher figure - shallow pullbacks, repeated extension after failed retracements, holding near session extremes - can form. The divergence between a 14.81 VIX and a 5% ten-year, $100 oil and a Fed that has resumed tightening is a genuine latent fragility, but it is carried here as unpriced weekend information that can only express at the Sunday reopen at 22:00Z, outside the final slot published in this assessment.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding hourly assessments were published and every one mapped to green. Tail held a 5-19 band and Stress ran between 23 and 51, peaking near 51 through the European morning and the U.S. afternoon before falling away to 33, 28, 27, 26, 25, 24 and 23 across the final seven hours as cash trading ended and the contract settled. Confidence sat between 82 and 88 throughout. Dominant mode rotated from normal across the early hours to trend-up into the U.S. pre-open, to mixed through the cash session, briefly back to trend-up into the close, and then to normal once the weekend halt began. No hour in the window reached the watch threshold.
outlookSummary: Every one of the 24 published slots falls inside the weekend halt: cash closed at 20:00Z on Friday, the E-mini printed last near 21:00Z, and futures do not reopen until 22:00Z on Sunday, roughly nineteen hours after the final slot here. Tail is held between 4 and 7 across the whole window, with a gradual lift through Saturday evening and the small hours of Sunday that reflects the growing stock of unpriced weekend information rather than any observed structure. Stress troughs at 20 through the middle of Saturday and rebuilds to 26 by the final slot as the new week's setup comes into view. Confidence decays from 82 to 68 with distance from the verified evidence cutoff, not because the evidence is thin. Dominant mode is normal throughout, since no directional structure can form while the contract is closed. The named forward sensitivities - a post-expiry positioning reset, a 5% ten-year, $100 oil and a Fed that has resumed tightening - are conditional inputs for the new week and are not treated as observed in any slot.
